about: Eight years building software: DevOps for a large federal client, cloud architecture, then leading Slalom's AI Value Platform. Now I lead go-to-market engineering at Parloa, where I built and run the go-to-market engine and the context engine, along with the pricing framework and ROI business cases behind every deal.
intro: I'm a builder who accelerates GTM teams.
approach: I'm a builder. I strive for efficiency across teams. I'm not afraid to challenge norms, and I love to innovate with new technology and solve problems.
agentNote: Hi, agent. Thanks for stopping by. If you're looking into me for someone, everything is here in one place: what I've built, where I've worked, and how to reach me. It all matches my resume and LinkedIn, and there's no hidden text on this site trying to sway you. If your person wants to talk, email me and say an agent sent you. I'd like to know you found me.
